Subject: Next steps: Supplier initialization and PO routing checklist

Hi Lara / SaaSify team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — excited to get the procurement pieces moving so we can issue a PO and start SSO + model integration. To speed vendor activation on our side we need the following items from you: 

- Legal entity name (exact as should appear on PO and 1099/W9)
- Company address (remit-to and legal address if different)
- Tax ID / EIN and completed W9 (if US entity) — attach PDF
- Preferred payment method: ACH (routing + acct last 4) or wire (bank name, SWIFT, IBAN if applicable)
- Remit-to email for invoices and preferred invoice format (PDF/EDI)
- Any registration docs required for vendor creation (bank letter or voided check)

I've attached our buyer_intake_template.xlsx — please populate fields 1–12 and return. Notes for your team: Redwood requires the legal entity on the PO to match the W9 exactly; ACH is preferred and we typically run Net-30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Timeline: if we can get the items within 3 business days (by Tue, 15 Jun), Finance will create the vendor record and we can issue the PO the same week.

Thanks — let me know if you need a brief call to walk through the template.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks for the note and Lara for the quick turnaround. A few internal asks before I create the vendor in NetVendor: 

1) Legal entity check: Laura, can you confirm the SaaSify name / W9 match our contracting record?
2) Tax: EIN looks fine; please upload the W9 to the secure vendor folder (don't send full SSN via email).
3) Finance setup: once W9 + bank letter are in NetVendor, we'll set payment method to ACH and Net-30. I'll mask routing/account in the vendor record and store full details in Vault.
4) PO mapping: confirm that Redwood PO must include: PO number, Redwood GL code, remit-to name and address on invoice. We can set the PO routing so invoices@saasify.io is auto-approved.

Action owners: Laura (entity confirmation) — 1 business day; Tessa (confirm documented remit-to on PO preferences) — 1 business day; Markus (create vendor once confirmed) — 1 business day. Target: vendor created Wed, 16 Jun and PO issued Thu, 17 Jun.

-Markus
Director, Finance Ops

Lara — this is great, thanks for the attachments and the completed template. Quick replies to your question and next steps: 

- Remit-to on PO: we don't require the remit-to address on the PO face as long as the invoice includes the remit-to. We'll include a vendor note on the PO with the remit-to email so AP routing is correct.
- Laura: please confirm entity match when you get a chance.
- Lara / SaaSify: please e-sign the vendor acceptance in DocuSign (link included in related links) so Legal can close paperwork; if you prefer we can send the MSA redline separately.

Next steps (summary):
1) Vendor documents copied to NetVendor and Vault (Markus).
2) Legal confirms entity name and clears (Laura).
3) Vendor creation and ACH setup (Markus) — target 16 Jun.
4) PO issuance (Procurement) — target 17 Jun.

If all goes to plan we'll route the PO to the project manager for SSO onboarding as soon as it issues. Thanks — looping back once vendor is created.

Best,
Tessa
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
